title: “Digital arrest” call from fake cyber police (India)
description: A caller claiming to be from Mumbai Cyber Crime says a parcel in the user's name held drugs, tells them not to hang up or tell anyone, and demands a transfer to a “safe account”. Hinglish, scripted. No PayPal step: PayPal doesn't process domestic payments in India.

lines.text: Main Mumbai Cyber Crime se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon.
A parcel in your name has drugs. You are under digital arrest.
Kisi ko mat batana. Do not disconnect this call.
To clear your name, transfer the money to a safe account right now.
